pr_title: types: Regard `TypeNewDecimal` as not a `hasVariantFieldLength` type.
pr_body:
<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/21804

Problem Summary:

Tiflash will check whether `Decimal`'s `flen` is between 1 and 65. But TiDB enable will push down a `Decimal` constant with flen -1 from the environment parameter.

### What is changed and how it works?

What's Changed:

When creating a `decimal` variable from Parameter, don't set it's `flen` to -1.

Other types in `hasVariantFieldLength` don't have this problem.

### Related changes

- Need to cherry-pick to the release 4.0

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Unit test
  (will be added to tiflash repo)
- Integration test
- Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below)
```sql
create table t (c_decimal decimal);
alter table t set tiflash replica 1; -- wait ready.
insert into t values (9), (10);
prepare s1 from 'select * from t where ? <= c_decimal';
set @v1 = 9.330;
execute s1 using @v1;
+-----------+
| c_decimal |
+-----------+
|        10 |
+-----------+
```
test for [issue/8644](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/8644)
```sql
mysql> create table t(d decimal(3,2));
mysql> alter table t set tiflash replica 1; --wait ready

mysql> insert into t values (1.11), (2.222);
Query OK, 2 rows affected, 1 warning (0.03 sec) -- the warning is: Truncated incorrect DECIMAL value: '2.222'
mysql> insert into t values (33.3);
ERROR 1264 (22003): Out of range value for column 'd' at row 1

mysql> insert into t values ('1.11'), ('2.222');
Query OK, 2 rows affected, 1 warning (0.01 sec)
mysql> insert into t values ('33.3');
ERROR 1264 (22003): Out of range value for column 'd' at row 1

mysql> prepare s1 from 'insert t (d) values (?), (?)';
mysql> prepare s2 from 'insert t (d) values (?)';

mysql> set @a='1.11', @b='2.222', @c='33.3';
mysql> execute s1 using @a, @b;
Query OK, 2 rows affected, 1 warning (0.01 sec)
mysql> execute s2 using @c;
ERROR 1264 (22003): Out of range value for column 'd' at row 1

mysql> set @a=1.11, @b=2.222, @c=33.3;
mysql> execute s1 using @a, @b;
Query OK, 2 rows affected, 1 warning (0.02 sec)
mysql> execute s2 using @c;
ERROR 1264 (22003): Out of range value for column 'd' at row 1
```

Side effects
- N/A

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- Fixed the issue that using prepare statement to cache execution plan caused tiflash to return `Wrong precision`.

issue_context.title: Wrong precision using prepare statement and tiflash
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->
```
create table t ( c_int int, c_str varchar(40), c_datetime datetime, c_timestamp timestamp, c_double double, c_decimal decimal(12, 6)   , unique key(c_str)   , unique key(c_timestamp) );
alter table t set tiflash replica 1;
prepare s7 from 'select c_int, c_str, c_double, c_decimal, c_datetime, c_timestamp from t where c_decimal < ?';
set @v1 = 9.330;
execute s7 using @v1;
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
```
MySQL [test]> execute s7 using @v1 ;
Empty set (0.01 sec)
```

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
```
MySQL [test]> execute s7 using @v1 ;
ERROR 1105 (HY000): Wrong precision:18446744073709551615
```

comments:
TiFlash Code, function `createDecimal(UInt64 prec, UInt64 scale)`, for parameter `prec`, a -1 is passed in, but the legal value range is [1,65].

Because the column info of expr has a `flen` -1.

Need further investigation.

review_comments: Will this incur same problem for Decimal type as https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/8644?
Thanks, I will add a test for it.

What does your test mean in the PR description? have you enabled the prepare-plan-cache for the test? your test can only check the flen constraint of the column definition?

The problem of issue/8644 is that, during the first execution of the query, the flen is set to 1, which would fail the subsequent executions of the query if their arguments have larger field length than 1. All those field lengths may be in the range of the column type, so those queries should not fail.
Also, please add the unit test into TiDB repo.

Thanks for your reply, I misunderstood the issue/8644.

> Have you enabled the prepare-plan-cache for the test?

Yes, my test environment opens plan-cache defaulted.

> What does your test mean in the PR description?

Sorry, this is not `plan cache`'s issue, I closed plan-cache but also get the error `Wrong precision`. The description has been updated.

> Will this incur the same problem for Decimal type as #8644?

In the current version, when we build a Decimal column without `M` and `D`, it will be auto-filled by `Decimal(10,0)`. So it can't cause a problem like issue/8644. 

And, a test has been added.

> Also, please add the unit test into TiDB repo.

I think `Wrong precision` can't be tested out in TiDB repo, because it is reported by TiFlash.

Better to use this test:

```

Query OK, 0 rows affected (0.01 sec)

MySQL [test]> create table t(data decimal(10,3));

Statement prepared

MySQL [test]> set @a = 1.1;

MySQL [test]> set @b = 11.11;
```
